titleTr: İleri phrasal verb'ler: sub plan geri bildirimi

grammar.topic: İleri phrasal verb'ler: ayrılabilen, ayrılamayan ve üç kelimelik
explainTr: Phrasal verb, fiil + edat/zarf birleşimidir ve anlamı çoğu zaman kelime kelime çeviriyle bulunmaz: carry out (yürütmek), hand out (dağıtmak), go over (gözden geçirmek), figure out (çözmek). Okulda ve iş notlarında çok geçer.

Ayrılabilen olanlarda nesne ortaya girebilir: hand out the papers = hand the papers out. Nesne zamir ise mutlaka ortaya girer: hand them out (hand out them yanlış). Ayrılamayanlarda nesne hep sonda kalır: look into the problem, deal with it, put up with the noise.

Üç kelimelik phrasal verb'ler de ayrılmaz: run out of (bitmek), catch up with (yetişmek), come up with (bulmak), put up with (katlanmak), cut down on (azaltmak). Notlarda 'sort out, back up, fall behind' gibi fiiller bir arada sık görülür.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'dağıtmak, gözden geçirmek, yetişmek' ayrı fiillerdir. İngilizcede aynı anlam fiil + küçük bir kelimeyle kurulur ve aynı fiil (go, put, take) farklı edatlarla tamamen farklı anlam taşır: go over (gözden geçirmek), go on (devam etmek).

look into / deal with / go over

run out of / put up with / come up with / catch up with

reading.title: Feedback from Ms. Carter
reading.text:
Dear Hafsa,

Thank you so much for covering my third-grade class last Thursday. I got back this morning and went over your sub notes with the students. I want to share some feedback, because I think you did a wonderful job for your first full day.

First, the good news. You handed out the morning worksheets without any confusion, and the class went over the instructions twice, as I had hoped. The students told me they felt calm, and several of them said you spoke slowly and clearly. Our classroom aide, Mr. Evans, also said that you carried out the schedule exactly as written. That is not easy on a first day.

Second, a few small suggestions. We ran out of colored markers during the art activity, and you had to figure out a plan quickly. You came up with a clever idea: students shared markers in pairs. Next time, I will leave extra supplies in the cabinet, and I will also back up my lesson files on the shared drive so you can find them easily.

Third, some students, especially Tyler and Maya, fell behind during the math lesson. You noticed it and sat with them, which was exactly right. I will look into giving them extra practice so they can catch up with the class. If a student continues to cause problems, you do not have to put up with it. Please write the name down and I will deal with it the next day.

Finally, I would like to cut down on the paperwork in your next sub folder. I will make a one-page summary, so you can sort out the day at a glance.

Overall, you were organized, kind, and patient, and the students asked if you can come back soon. I would be glad to have you again next month.

Warm regards,
Ms. Carter

writing.promptTr: Vekil öğretmenlik yaptığın günün sonunda sınıf öğretmenine bir not yaz (120-180 kelime): neler yaptın, hangi sorunlar çıktı, nasıl çözdün, önerilerin neler? En az beş phrasal verb kullan.
writing.promptEn: After a day as a substitute teacher, write a note to the regular teacher (120-180 words). Say what you did, what problems came up, how you solved them, and what you suggest. Use at least five phrasal verbs.
frames: I handed out ... and went over ...
We ran out of ..., so I came up with ...
Two students fell behind, so I ...
Next time, you could cut down on / look into ...
writing.model:
Dear Ms. Carter,

Thank you for letting me cover your class today. I would like to share a few notes. In the morning, I handed out the reading sheets and went over the instructions with the students. Everyone started quickly. During the art activity, we ran out of glue, so I came up with a plan: the students worked in pairs and shared. Two students, Ben and Lily, fell behind in math. I sat with them for ten minutes, and they were able to catch up. Unfortunately, I could not figure out how to turn on the projector, so I used the whiteboard instead. I wrote down the names of the students who talked during the lesson, and you can deal with it tomorrow. For next time, you could cut down on the paper in the sub folder, and it would help to label the supplies. Overall, it was a good day, and I would be happy to come back.

Sincerely,
Hafsa Yilmaz
checklistTr: En az beş phrasal verb kullandın mı (hand out, go over, run out of, catch up, deal with...)?
Ayrılabilen phrasal verb'lerde zamir ortada mı (hand them out)?
Not 'Dear...' ile başlayıp 'Sincerely' ile bitiyor mu?
Sorun, çözüm ve öneri bölümleri var mı?
